steps.en: Install a release build and start the app with its local control channel open
steps.zh: 装好发布版，启动应用并打开本地控制通道

steps.en: Point your agent's MCP config at the running app
steps.zh: 把 agent 的 MCP 配置指向这个正在运行的应用

steps.en: Ask the agent for the deck: slides, charts, transitions
steps.zh: 让 agent 做稿：页面、图表、切换效果

steps.en: Runs each agent call as the same undoable command a ribbon button runs
steps.zh: 把 agent 的每次调用当成功能区按钮的同一条命令执行，可撤销

steps.en: Renders slides back as images so the agent can check its own layout
steps.zh: 把页面渲染成图片回传，agent 能自己检查版面

steps.en: Fix what you dislike by hand in the same window, or undo the agent's steps
steps.zh: 在同一个窗口里手工改不满意的地方，或撤销 agent 的步骤

steps.en: Saves the deck as .pptx, or exports PDF with a selectable text layer
steps.zh: 存成 .pptx，或导出带可选中文字层的 PDF

value.en: A PowerPoint-format deck you and an agent built together in one open-source app — no Office licence, no blind .pptx scripting
value.zh: 你和 agent 在一个开源应用里合做出 PowerPoint 格式的稿子，不要 Office 授权，也不盲写脚本
